annotator_notes: ClinSpark/DrVince annotated CRF, 206 pages. Page header is generic ('384-201-00004 / Annotated CRF / N of 206 / drvince.clinspark.com') - it does NOT carry the form title. Form titles come from the PDF bookmark tree (Forms section) and are printed as a doubled banner only on a form's FIRST page; later pages of a multi-page form omit it (form_source=carryover). Each field = the human-readable prompt line immediately followed by a '[OID]' and '[SAS Field Name: X]' pair and an input widget (O options or [___] box). Interview/help sentences under a label, 'Help Text', 'Comment', item-group headers (Odm OID = IG.*), 'Code List', 'Format', 'Origin', 'Odm OID', 'Description', 'Mandatory?' metadata are NOT fields. Repeated identical labels on one page (e.g. 'If yes, describe:') collapse to one. The back matter (Units of Measure, Code Lists) are reference tables with zero data-entry fields.
